image_basis: review/after-contact.png at 560 x 560; same recipe camera reconstructed from the final scene
interpretation: The ROI contains the foreground rounded terminal corner (stations 0-8 and end cap), plus the tray-to-back bend behind it (stations 80-94). The selected bright pixel [290,332] hits the real terminal corner at station 4, not an extra component. A same-geometry diffuse/cap-colour diagnostic removes the concentrated silver highlight while preserving the rounded silhouette. This supports a specular/corner-normal explanation, not a claim of dynamic z-fighting verification. Whole-mesh topology/envelope/coplanar gates are separate evidence.
geometry_limits: 4 mm in-plane terminal corner and 0.65 mm section micro-round are real mesh. Terminal end-cap edge in thickness direction is not an all-direction fillet.
